subject: Shadow traffic quality metrics — PRD review + launch criteria + sign-offs (Phase 0→Beta)
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 10, 2026 at 9:14 AM
Subject: Shadow traffic quality metrics — PRD review + launch criteria + sign-offs (Phase 0→Beta)

Priya — looping you in as exec sponsor. We’re ready for PRD sign-off for the “shadow traffic tool for eval metrics” work.

Goal: mirror a sampled subset of production requests to one+ candidate variants (new model version / quant profile / routing policy / prompt template), score shadow outputs async, and surface quality deltas next to latency/cost without impacting the user response.

Docs / trackers:
- PRD (Confluence): confluence://product-docs/requirements/shadow-traffic-eval-metrics-prd
- Routing ADR: confluence://architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-shadow-traffic-routing-architecture
- Metrics data model + cardinality ADR: confluence://architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-shadow-metrics-data-model-and-cardinality
- Data retention/redaction policy draft: confluence://security-and-compliance/data-residency-and-retention/shadow-traffic-data-retention-and-redaction
- Linear: PM-1842 (PRD), PM-1843 (default metric set v1), PM-1844 (beta plan), PM-1846 (quality signals into rollout guardrails)

Ask (today if possible): sign-off on Phase 0 scope + launch criteria for limited beta (Dedicated tenants first).

Proposed Beta launch criteria (draft checklist attached):
1) Fail-open: shadow path failures never impact user response; hard timeouts; circuit breakers.
2) Overhead budget met: no measurable p99 regression on control path in perf-canary runs at default sampling.
3) Telemetry schema + cardinality controls approved by Observability (limits on route_id/model_id, no prompt_id/customer_id as labels).
4) Data handling: prompt/response retention defaults to short window; redaction in place; Dedicated can configure; Private has explicit constraints documented.
5) Scoring pipeline SLOs + oncall: lag alerts, backlog thresholds, dashboards, and kill switch.
6) Console UX: create/view shadow experiment, deltas with confidence intervals, example drilldown with access controls.
7) Rollouts integration: link shadow experiments to canaries/A-B objects (advisory quality gates for beta).

Scheduling: can you do 20 min today (11:30–11:50 PT) or we can do async approvals in-thread.

Thanks,
Marissa
Product, Console & Rollouts
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- shadow-traffic-eval-metrics-prd-v0.9.pdf
- launch-criteria-checklist-shadow-traffic-beta.docx

---

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 10, 2026 at 10:02 AM
Subject: Re: Shadow traffic quality metrics — PRD review + launch criteria + sign-offs (Phase 0→Beta)

+1 on moving this forward.

From Telemetry/Analytics perspective, I’m good with Phase 0/1 provided we lock the following in the PRD “Constraints / Guardrails” section:

- Event types: shadow_pair_created, shadow_pair_completed, scoring_completed (names can change but we need the 3-stage lifecycle).
- Required dimensions only: route_id (hashed/short), control_variant_id, shadow_variant_id, region, request_type (chat/embeddings/etc), outcome.
- Explicitly disallow high-cardinality tags in metrics (customer_id, user_id, request_id, prompt_id); those can exist only as sampled logs with retention.
- Sampling math: sampling decision recorded once per request fingerprint; same bucket across time windows.
- Storage: default 7d raw artifacts max for Hosted; Dedicated can opt into 30d with ticket + cost acknowledgment; Private default off unless configured.

If we incorporate the above, I can sign off on the telemetry pieces for beta.

Logan

---

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 10, 2026 at 10:27 AM
Subject: Re: Shadow traffic quality metrics — PRD review + launch criteria + sign-offs (Phase 0→Beta)

Adding SRE POV.

I’m supportive, but I want the beta launch gate to be explicit that we are NOT doing automatic rollback on quality signals at first. Advisory only.

Also need hard requirements:
- Global kill switch for shadowing (control plane) that can be flipped without deploy.
- Circuit breaker thresholds documented: if scoring queue lag > X or ingestion error rate > Y, shadowing auto-disables per-tenant.
- No shadow requests should consume customer quotas / rate limits (or we need a dedicated “shadow budget” that can’t starve control).
- Oncall readiness: dashboards + alert routing + runbook link in the pager message.

If we get these in the PRD + the runbook exists before beta, I’ll sign off.

Sean
SRE Lead

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 10, 2026 at 11:06 AM
Subject: Re: Shadow traffic quality metrics — PRD review + launch criteria + sign-offs (Phase 0→Beta)

Thanks both — aligned.

Updates I’ll make now:
- Add explicit “Beta: advisory quality signals only” (no auto rollback). (ties to PM-1846)
- Add the 3-stage telemetry lifecycle + allowed dimensions + the “no high-cardinality labels” rule. (ties to ENG-5404)
- Add guardrails: global kill switch, per-tenant auto-disable thresholds, and “shadow budget doesn’t count against customer quota / can’t starve control.” (ties to ENG-5415)

Priya — once those edits are in, would you be comfortable with an exec sign-off so teams can proceed into Phase 0/1 without more review cycles?

Also: I’d like to keep beta scoped to Dedicated tenants only (2–3 design partners), with Hosted dogfood internal only.

Marissa

---

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 10, 2026 at 12:18 PM
Subject: Re: Shadow traffic quality metrics — PRD review + launch criteria + sign-offs (Phase 0→Beta)

Yes, assuming the edits you listed are reflected and we keep beta to Dedicated only.

Two additions from platform leadership:
1) Make the “fail-open” property measurable. I want a clear acceptance test: simulate shadow target failures + scoring backlog and demonstrate no change in control response success rate or p99 latency. Add that as a gate.
2) Ensure data handling defaults are conservative and documented. If the retention/redaction policy isn’t final, beta should ship with the strictest defaults and a customer-visible note in the Console.

If you incorporate those, consider this exec sign-off for Phase 0/1. Please also post the final PRD link in Linear PM-1842 and tag the ENG epics so the dependencies are unblocked.

Priya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 10, 2026 at 2:03 PM
Subject: Re: Shadow traffic quality metrics — PRD review + launch criteria + sign-offs (Phase 0→Beta)

Done — PRD updated.

Changes made:
- Beta: quality signals are advisory only (no auto rollback). Linked to linear://PM-1846.
- Added explicit acceptance tests for fail-open behavior (shadow target failures + scoring backlog scenarios) and perf gates (control path p99 unchanged at default sampling). Tied to linear://ENG-5415 and perf-canary suite.
- Telemetry: added lifecycle events + required dimensions only; banned high-cardinality labels; added retention defaults.
- Data handling: clarified strict defaults for beta + Console callout; linked the retention/redaction policy draft.

PRD link again: confluence://product-docs/requirements/shadow-traffic-eval-metrics-prd
Linear updates in progress in PM-1842 (I’ll drop the link + checklist into the ticket).

Logan/Sean — can you reply “approved” (or any remaining concerns) so I can capture formal sign-off in PM-1842?

Marissa

Logan

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Jan 10, 2026 at 5:46 PM
Subject: Re: Shadow traffic quality metrics — PRD review + launch criteria + sign-offs (Phase 0→Beta)

Approved from SRE, with the caveat that we don’t start any external beta until:
- runbook exists and is linked in alert definitions
- kill switch is validated in staging
- initial alert thresholds are set to ticket-only (no paging) for the first week of internal dogfood, then revisit

If you log these as explicit gates in PM-1842 / ENG-5409 / ENG-5415, we’re good.

Sean
